description: Bounded Rietveld verification recipe (unit 07). Refines ONLY the allowlisted parameter budget against a deterministic GSAS-II observed pattern derived from the catalog CIF. Explicitly prohibited: anything that can absorb structural mismatch (unrestrained atoms, microstrain, size, hydrostatic strain, phase fractions, preferred orientation, LeBail).

observable.truth_source: catalog CIF -> deterministic GSAS-II simulation (same protocol as catalog fingerprints)
observable.noise: none (unit-07 noiseless protocol; instrument/noise robustness is unit 05's mandate)
